chunk_findings.detail: The new live-lease refusal always returns when `held is not None` and never reads a force flag or reason, but the message it returns (and that `test_merge_of_another_clones_live_lease_is_refused` pins) tells the caller to override with `--force --reason`. A non-holder running merge on T2 with a live lease held by U9 and `--force --reason 'holder process is dead'` still hits this return and is refused, so the only recovery path the error itself documents cannot land the item.

chunk_findings.detail: The peer-lease guard decides whether to run from `agent` (`ID.is_agent(agent)`) but asks `peer_live_lease` whether the lease is someone else's using `caller=log.agent_id`, not `caller=agent` (the caller the foreign-lease check on the line above, and the pre-change `peer_live_lease` call, both use). Those two ids are not the same value. Input: same-clone live lease on T2 held by U9, `log.agent_id` is U9, and a different agent merges with `--agent U2` (the Bddda807b51 shape: events attributed to high5 while sw-ciguards holds the lease). `is_agent("U2")` is true, but `peer_live_lease(..., caller="U9")` treats the lease as the caller's own and returns None, so merge still lands, releases U9's lease, and removes the worktree. The swap also refuses the real holder: U9 merges with `--agent U9` while `log.agent_id` is the clone id U1; `peer_live_lease(caller="U1")` reports U9's own live lease and blocks the holder. The new test only passes when `run_cli(..., agent="U2")` happens to make `log.agent_id` equal `U2`, so it does not catch either case.

data.probe: Refuted: caller=log.agent_id is EXACTLY what release() uses (heartbeat.py:296), and it is the resolved identity of the acting process -- under '--agent U2' _load resolves log.agent_id to 'U2', while the holder records log.agent_id='U9' at claim, so peer_live_lease(caller='U2') correctly sees holder U9 as a peer. The e2e tests prove it: test_merge_of_a_peer_agents_live_lease_is_refused (U2 refused) and test_the_operator_merge_of_a_peer_lease_is_not_lease_refused (operator exempt) both pass. The mirror of D-mu-bugfix-answers clone scope is deliberate.
